title: Pine Computer
description_en: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done. Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.
description_zh: Pine Computer是为AI Agent设计的云端计算环境基础设施。核心创新在于：①不依赖API，Agent可直接操作任何Web应用（表单、电子表格、企业门户）②通过读取应用DOM结构而非OCR像素，实现精确理解和操作③支持多虚拟屏幕并发，单个Agent可同时处理多任务④提供SDK让产品方为每个客户分配独立计算实例⑤支持人机协作，关键节点（登录/审批）可人工介入⑥可接入自有模型或使用其提供的模型。目标用户是需要Agent执行跨应用工作流的B2B SaaS产品，解决了Agent无法操作传统软件的核心痛点。当前处于邀请制Beta阶段，已有SDK可集成。

title: Opposable
description_en: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs. Opposable lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent see, tap and type on a real iPhone or Android phone, in every app you're signed into. Common tasks run on the phone with no model at all, payments wait for your tap, and iPhones work through Bluetooth or a tiny USB stick.
description_zh: Opposable解决AI Agent无法操作移动端App的根本问题。产品通过MCP协议让Claude Code、Codex等Agent直接控制真实iPhone/Android设备——Agent可以看到屏幕内容、执行点击、输入文字，访问用户已登录的所有App。核心机制：常见任务在手机本地执行无需调用模型（降低成本），涉及支付等敏感操作会等待用户确认，iPhone通过蓝牙或微型USB连接。这是真正的'Computer Use for Phones'，让AI获得'拇指'能力。目标用户是需要自动化移动端操作的开发者、Agent构建者。产品刚在PH发布获81票，属于极早期但方向极其前沿——移动端Agent控制是公认的技术空白区。

title: Busabase
description_en: The general system of record for AI agents. Different agents. One shared base. Busabase is a general-purpose database and workspace for people and AI agents. Keep business records, docs, skills, and apps in one place so the next task can build on them. Connect Claude Code, Codex, and more. Set access, review changes when needed, and see what changed. Busabase is open source, with Cloud, Personal Desktop, and self-hosting options.

full_profile.biz_model_zh: 双轨制收费：①标准版抽成模式，每笔交易收取0.5%（相比Stripe 2.9%+$0.3已经很低）②Pro版固定$25/月，零抽成。定价逻辑是让小开发者低门槛试用（0.5%几乎无感），规模化后切换Pro版更划算。用户愿意付费因为：省去自建支付系统的开发成本（通常需2-4周工程时间），且无需维护后端。但与Gumroad/Lemon Squeezy等成熟平台相比，Chrome扩展这个垂直场景的差异化不够明显，且0.5%抽成可能难以覆盖运营成本。
full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：这是典型的开发者工具基础设施机会，但Alpha有限。①方向价值：Chrome扩展市场确实缺乏原生变现工具，开发者痛点真实存在（Manifest V3迁移后更多扩展需要付费模式）②被低估之处：如果能垄断Chrome扩展支付入口，有网络效应潜力，类似Stripe早期。③核心风险：a)市场规模天花板低（Chrome扩展开发者总量有限）b)Google随时可能推出官方支付方案 c)竞品如ExtensionPay已存在 d)0.5%抽成商业模式可持续性存疑。④投资论文适配度：不符合我们对AI-native和高壁垒的要求，更像是传统SaaS基础设施的小众版本，缺乏数据飞轮和AI进
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得8分：产品提到可通过coding agent集成，但本质是传统支付SDK，无AI核心能力，无数据飞轮，无自进化机制。Niche得16分：Chrome扩展变现是真实但小众的垂直场景，有一定场景护城河（需要深度理解Chrome Extension API和支付合规），但技术壁垒不高，ExtensionPay等竞品已存在，可替代性较强。商业模式得13分：订阅+抽成的混合模式清晰，但0.5%抽成可能无法覆盖成本，Pro版$25/月定价合理但需要足够用户基数。团队得8分：仅知道maker是miltostave，无背景信息，疑似独立开发者，无AI或支付领域特殊背景。加4分：产品已上线可用，有基本的PMF验证。减9分：PH仅68票证明市场反应冷淡-3分，信息严重不足（无团队/融资/用户数据）-3分，非AI-native的传统工具-3分。

full_profile.insight_zh: 这个提交完全不符合Creekstone的投资范畴。这不是产品、不是公司、不是技术方案，而是一个哲学性讨论话题。虽然AI发展趋势的讨论对理解市场有参考价值，但讨论本身不构成投资标的。这反映了数据抓取系统可能存在误判：将包含'AI'关键词的HN讨论帖误识别为AI产品。建议优化筛选逻辑，排除Ask HN/Show HN中的纯讨论帖，聚焦真实的产品发布和公司介绍。这类内容对投资决策的唯一价值是了解社区对AI的情绪和认知趋势。
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得0分：这不是产品，无法评估AI能力。Niche得0分：这是讨论话题，不存在技术壁垒或细分市场定位。商业模式得0分：完全没有商业模式，是免费的社区讨论。团队得0分：consumer451只是HN用户ID，不是创始人，无团队信息。扣10分惩罚：这是严重的信息误判，将非产品内容纳入评审流程，浪费评审资源。总分0分是因为评分体系不适用于非商业实体的讨论内容。
full_profile.metrics_summary: HN数据：13个点赞，28条评论，发布于2026年10月9日（注：这个未来日期可能是数据错误）。无GitHub stars、无Product Hunt数据、无用户数、无ARR、无任何商业指标。这些数据仅反映HN社区对该讨论话题的参与度，不代表任何产品或公司的表现。

title: Playground by Google Labs
description_en: Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI. Google Playground is an experimental AI gaming platform that lets anyone create, play, and share custom games without coding. Describe your idea, choose a genre, and let AI build a playable game in minutes. Change the rules, characters, physics, or visuals simply by chatting. Share your creation with friends, publish it to the community gallery, or explore games made by others. Powered by Google's Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria models.

title: Odyssey 3
description_en: A world model that simulates physics in real time. Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

title: Gemini Agent for Google Cloud
description_en: The work agent that runs on both Gemini and Claude. Gemini agent is Google Cloud's single, universal agent for work. Give it an objective, not instructions: it plans, uses your company's skills and tools, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira or any MCP server, and hands back finished docs, decks or code. Unlike chat assistants that stop at an answer, it keeps running in the cloud for hours or days, spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar, and routes each job to the right model under hard spend caps.

title: Claude Dashboards & Motion
description_en: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers. Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

title: Cue
description_en: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing. Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

title: Microsoft-Decision-1
description_en: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows. Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

title: Staffcoder
description_en: Build like a real engineer. Staffcoder is a hands-on coding platform where developers practice real engineering work instead of algorithm puzzles. Choose from 1000+ challenges across 39 learning paths, covering React, Next.js, Django, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, AI agents, and more. Every challenge runs in a full browser IDE with a real terminal, file system, and live preview, so there is nothing to install. Pick a stack, open a challenge, and build. Free to start.

title: Refs
description_en: Give Claude better references for your videos. Refs is a library of 3000+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

title: AgentSDR
description_en: Open-source AI SDR. The open-source AI SDR workspace that replaces Clay, Smartlead, HubSpot, and many more. Run email sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, and WhatsApp outreach with built-in data enrichment and automations, backed by an AI CRM that automatically classifies replies and drafts responses. Self-hosted with your own AI keys.

title: OpenPilot
description_en: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose. OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

title: BrightBean Studio
description_en: Open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams. BrightBean Studio is a free, open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams, agencies and small businesses. Schedule and publish to 10+ platforms, manage approvals, analytics and inboxes, and connect AI agents through the built-in MCP server and REST API.

title: Amazon Alexa Tablets
description_en: Full Google Play, Alexa+ and a Kindle reading mode. Amazon Alexa Tablets are a new Android lineup with full Google Play access and Alexa+ built in. Available in 8.7-inch, 11-inch, and 12-inch sizes, they bring on-screen AI assistance, live conversations, a distraction-free Kindle reading mode, and an optional Nanomatte display on the 12 Pro.

title: Skreno
description_en: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser. Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

title: Melete
description_en: An Always On Personal Agent With a Team Workspace. Meet Melete, Your Personal Agent, on your hardware. The more you use AI, the more you have to teach it. Every new chat means explaining the project again. Melete is a personal AI agent with its own computer. It remembers what you're working on, keeps unfinished jobs moving while you're away, and picks a project back up weeks later without starting over. Melete Cloud is open for waitlist signups. For companies, we're taking a small number of pilot teams.

title: Maildun for Mac
description_en: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP. Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

title: Request Eagle
description_en: Fast and open-source Postman alternative. Request Eagle is an open-source API client written in Rust and drawn on the GPU, with no web view. It answers your first keystroke 0.36 s after launch, keeps requests as TOML files you can commit, runs Postman-style pm.* scripts and has a CLI for AI agents.
